items.title: What ClickUp’s mass layoff tells us about the future of work

_source_config.name: TechCrunch
_source_config.reason: 创投科技媒体，需筛选AI创业、产品相关

items.ai_target_audience: Business leaders, HR professionals, startup executives, and designers interested in organizational trends within tech companies.
items.ai_key_insights: The article examines how mass layoffs at ClickUp reflect broader shifts in workplace structure, automation, and the prioritization of profitability over rapid scaling, offering lessons on sustainable growth and employee experience design.
items.ai_recommendation: 虽然非直接设计内容，但揭示了组织变革对设计团队规模和协作模式的深远影响，值得设计师反思未来职业韧性。

items.title: 既然谷歌已不再是曾经的谷歌，有哪些替代的搜索引擎？

_source_config.name: TechCrunch
_source_config.reason: 创投科技媒体，需筛选AI创业、产品相关

items.ai_target_audience: 对隐私、搜索体验和工具效率敏感的设计师、产品经理及科技爱好者
items.ai_key_insights: 从谷歌搜索体验下滑出发，梳理具备差异化UI、隐私保护、垂直搜索等特性的替代引擎，为注重体验与效率的用户提供可操作的迁移指南
items.ai_recommendation: 即使不做迁移，也能启发设计师对比不同搜索界面的信息架构与交互模式。
